info.name: CERTInext APIs
info.description:
Welcome to the CERTInext API Documentation. If you are new to APIs, we suggest familiarizing yourself with the fundamentals before diving into this service. CERTInext is a unified platform providing simplified access to all certificate lifecycle management operations. It is a user-friendly certificate management platform that allows customers to easily manage and monitor their certificates.

**Audience**

This document is intended for developers who want to offer and integrate CERTInext Certificate Lifecycle Management services in external applications by utilizing our complete set of APIs. This document can be further followed to learn more about API interactions.

**Before You Begin**

To get started with CERTInext REST APIs, you need the following:

- A CERTInext account
    
- An API Key (Access Key) generated from within the platform
    

For every request you have to pass an API key as authentication, which can be generated using your CERTInext account. These APIs are available to use for both partners and enterprises.

As you become familiar with CERTInext, you interact with different environments, each of which may have different sign-in URLs, API base URLs, and account credentials. To know more about Accounts and environments, please see the below table.

**Accounts and environments**

| **Environment** | **Sign-in URL** | **API Base URL** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sandbox | [Sandbox Sign-in URL](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | [https://sandbox-us-api.certinext.io/emSignHub-API/](https://sandbox-us-api.certinext.io/emSignHub-API/) |
| Production - India (Global) | [Sign-in URL (India)](https://in.certinext.io/) | [https://api.certinext.io/](https://api.certinext.io/) |
| Production - US | [Sign-in URL (US)](https://us.certinext.io/) | [https://us-api.certinext.io/](https://us-api.certinext.io/) |

**Go Live**

Once you have successfully tested the APIs in sandbox environment, please switch to production API URLs and proceed with Go live.

Before sending your requests to the production environment, please ensure to change the product codes.

item.name: REST APIs
Overview
item.description:
CERTInext is the unified platform enabling users to avail digital transformation products & all the portfolio of offerings under emSign in self-managed manner. This documentation covers the following:

- Accounts API
    
- Orders API
    
- Certificates API
    
- Reporting API
    

**What is included**

This document intends to describe the emSign Product Order Life Cycle with the following API services:

- **ValidateCredentials**: This API allows you to validate the API access credentials of your CERTInext user account.
    
- **GetGroupDetails:** This API allows you to get group details associated with the respective account user. Groups can be your cost centers, departments, etc. within your Business. It acts as a feature / tool for managing account user access to organizations, domains and use its finances.
    
- **GetOrganizationDetails**: This API allows you to get detailed organization information and its status.
    
- **GetDomainDetails:** This API allows you to get detailed domain information and its status.
    
- **GenerateOrderSSL**: This API allows you to generate emSign SSL – DV / OV / EV certificate orders.
    
- **GenerateOrderSMIME**: This API allows you to generate emSign S/MIME – Simple certificate orders.
    
- **GenerateOrderSignature**: This API allows you to generate emSign signature - Natural Person / Legal Person / Legal Entity certificate orders.
    
- **SubmitCSR**: This API allows you to submit CSR for all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **SubmitDocument**: This API allows you to submit the documents for all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **GetDcv**: This API allows you to get DCV (Domain Control Validation) details for all emSign SSL/TLS certificate orders.
    
- **VerifyDcv**: This API allows you to verify DCV (Domain Control Validation) for all emSign SSL/TLS certificate orders.
    
- **TrackOrder**: This API allows tracking the order status of all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **GetCertificate**: This API allows download of all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **RevokeOrder**: This API allows revocation of all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **RejectOrder**: This API allows cancellation of all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.
    
- **GetOrderReport**: This API allows you to get order report of all emSign (SSL/TLS, S/MIME, Signature) certificates orders.

item.name: How to Get Started
item.description: To get started with CERTInext REST APIs, follow the steps below to generate your API credentials and begin integrating your platform. #### **Step 1: Navigate to the APIs Page** Log in to your CERTInext account and navigate to: **Integrations → APIs** The APIs page provides access to credentials required for integrating with CERTInext certificate management protocols including ACME, REST API, EST, SCEP, CMP and WAEP. From this page you can create new credentials, manage access, view or revoke credentials as needed. #### Step 2: Create New API Credentials Click + Create API Credentials at the top right of the APIs page. The Create API Credentials dialog will open. #### Step 3: Configure REST API Credentials In the Create API Credentials dialog, fill in the following fields: | Field | Description | Required | | --- | --- | --- | | API Type | Select REST from the dropdown | Required | | Description | Enter a meaningful label for this credential set (e.g. rest_api, my-app-integration) | Required | | User | Select the CERTInext user account this credential will be associated with | Required | | Auth Type | Select the authentication method - Access Key or OAuth | Required | | Tags | Optionally add tags for filtering and organization | Optional | Once all fields are completed, click **Generate**. #### Step 4: Copy Your Access Key Once generated, the View API Key Credentials dialog will display your Access Key. Copy and store this key securely - it will be used in the Authorization header of all your API requests. #### Step 5: Confirm Credential Status Your newly created REST API credential will now appear in the APIs list with status Active. A confirmation message - REST API Credentials generated successfully will be displayed at the top of the page. #### Step 6: View Status History To verify the activation status and history of any credential, select Status History from the Action dropdown next to the credential. The View Status History dialog shows the status update date, access key status and the user who last updated it. #### Managing API Credentials All created credentials are listed on the Integrations → APIs page. The following columns are shown for each credential: #### Authentication All REST API requests must include authentication details passed in the Meta object of every request. The following fields are required in the Meta for each API call: **authKey Generation** The authKey is not your raw Access Key. It must be computed as follows: authKey = SHA256(accessKey + requestTs + requestTxnId) Example: If your values are: - accessKey = your REST API Access Key from the CERTInext portal - requestTs = the ts value used in the request - requestTxnId = the txn value used in the request Then: authKey = SHA256(accessKey + ts + txn) **Note:** - The Access Key used in the authKey computation is the value generated in the CERTInext portal under Integrations → APIs. - Refer to the steps above to generate your Access Key. - OAuth is also supported where enabled on your account. Select OAuth as the Auth Type during credential creation to use this method.

request.description:
This API facilitates to generate new order for all emSign - SSL / TLS - OV Wildcard certificates. **Prerequisites** eMudhra provides following values for generating SSL OV Orders. It is highly recommended to keep these values configurable, as they change for sandbox environment and Live environment. - Generate SSL Order Base URL Endpoint - Product Codes | **Region** | **URL** | | --- | --- | | US | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | | Global | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | **API Endpoint** | Header | Header | | --- | --- | | URL | http(s)://(url host port and path)/GenerateOrderSSL | | Protocol | HTTP/ HTTPS | | Method | POST | | Content Type | JSON | | Post data | A well-formed JSON, as per the specifications provided in this document. | **Request JSON format** Below is the JSON structure in which the request has to be formed. It must be well formed with correct syntax. ``` { "meta": { "ver":"", "ts":"", "txn":"", "accountNumber":"", "authKey":"" }, "orderDetails": { "productCode": "", "accountingModel": "", "saveAndHold": "", "requestNumber": "", "emailNotifications": "", "groupNumber ": "", "requestorInformation": { "requestorName": "", "requestorIsdCode": "", "requestorMobileNumber": "", "requestorEmail": "", "requestorDesignation": "" }, "delegationInformation": { "contactName": "", "email": "" }, "organizationDetails": { "preVetting": "", "organizationNumber": "", "prevettingToken": "", "representativeNumber": "" }, "certificateInformation": { "organizationName":"", "organizationUnit":"", "streetAddress1":"", "streetAddress2":"", "locality":"", "state":"", "countryCode":"", "postalCode":"", "domainName":"", "additionalDomains": [ "", "", ], "autoSecureWWW": "" }, "agreementDetails": { "acceptAgreement": "", "signerName": "", "signerPlace": "", "signerIP": "" }, "subscriptionDetails": { "validity": "", "autoRenew": "", "renewCriteria": "" }, "csr":"", "numberOfDocuments":"", "documentsAttached": [ { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" }, { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" } ], "additionalInformation": { "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" }, { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" } ], "remarks": "", "recipientEmail": "", "technicalPointOfContact": { "pocName":"", "pocEmail":"", "pocIsdCode":"", "pocMobileNumber":"", "pocDesignation":"" } } } } ``` **Specification** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | meta | (mandatory)
Specified Below. | | orderDetails | (mandatory)
Order details of the respective order.
Specified Below. | **Meta** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | ver | 1.0 (mandatory)
Version should be set to "1.0". | | ts | 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30 (mandatory)
Time stamp of request in ISO 8601 format. Example: 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30. Use Time zone to indicate the requesting server time. Else, it considers as Indian Time Zone. | | txn | 1234567890 (mandatory)
A unique transaction ID of the request. This should be unique for given Account. This should be an alphanumeric value between 10 to 50 characters. | | accountNumber | 6288275133 (mandatory)
Unique Account Number of CERTInext Account. This information will be available within CERTInext online portal. | | authKey | 952a95057654aa1c26a0f287b6368579f5f3ec99f213543df5e0f7eb7f798b3d (mandatory)
This should be the SHA 256 hash value of Account User Access Key Value along with Time Stamp and Transaction ID. Account User's REST API Access Key can be generated within CERTInext online portal. Example: SHA256 (accessKey + requestTs + requestTxnId). | **Order Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | productCode | 841 (mandatory)
Unique Product Code of the respective product. Product Code values are provided by eMudhra. | | accountingModel | 1 (optional)
Accounting Model of the Account.
The allowed value for this field is: 1 - Cash Model. The default value is '1' (in case if it is not set). | | saveAndHold | 0 (mandatory)
Should be set to any of the numeric values.
1 - Only Request ID will be generated and request will be pending for payment.
0 - Both Request ID & Order ID will be generated. | | requestNumber | 8785645678 (mandatory)
Request Number of the existing request which was saved as a draft.
This field is 'mandatory' only for the requests (Request ID is available & Order ID is yet to generate). | | emailNotifications | 1 (mandatory)
Can contain one of the numeric values as under. Default is '1'.
0 - Pre-vetting Organization (Organization & Subscriber Agreement info.) re-use consent notification will be sent to the applicant on order initiation, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'.
1 - All Order Notifications will be sent to the applicant on order initiation. | | groupNumber | 3589463147 (optional)
Group Number of the group. This is auto generated by the system. Groups can be your cost centers, departments, etc. within your Business.
It acts as a feature / tool for managing account user access to organizations, domains and finances. If group number is not given in the request, then system will consider the default group number and amount will be deducted from the account balance. If group is having its own balance, then amount will be deducted from the group balance else the amount will be deducted from the account balance. | | requestorInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | delegationInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | organizationDetails | (optional)
Specified below. | | certificateInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | agreementDetails | (conditional mandatory)
Signer details of the respective order to complete the Subscriber Agreement automatically. This is mandatory, if "preVetting" value is set to '0'. Specified Below. | | subscriptionDetails | (conditional mandatory)
Subscription Details of the order. | | csr | Optional | | numberOfDocuments | (optional)
Number of Documents attached. | | documentsAttached | (optional)
Uploading documents during order creation is recommended for sending us any additional / supporting documents so that they are automatically associated with your certificate order. This additional documentation would help emSign to speed up the certificate validation process. (E.g., incorporation letter, registration document, etc.). Specified below. | | additionalInformation | (optional)
Specified below. | **Requestor Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | requestorName | John Doe (mandatory)
Name of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorIsdCode | +1 (mandatory)
ISD Code of the requestor's / Org. Representative's mobile number. | | requestorMobileNumber | 8978945116 (mandatory)
Mobile number of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorEmail | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorDesignation | PM (optional)
Designation of the requestor / Org. Representative. | **Delegation Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | contactName | John Doe (mandatory)
Contact Name of the delegated person. | | email | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email ID of the delegated person. | **Organization Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | preVetting | 1 (mandatory)
This can be set to any of the numeric values as under. Default is '0'.
0 - No (New Organization)
1 - Yes (Pre-verified Domain of pre-vetted Organization). You are allowed to use Pre-verified EV Organizations in OV Orders as well. | | organizationNumber | 2943849 (conditional mandatory)
Organization Number (Org. ID) of the existing organization associated to the respective emSign account of the certificate requester.
This is mandatory, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | prevettingToken | 0947CBA3C2DF42B0B303590541C8E5B1 (optional)
Please specify the unique pre-vetted token value associated to the respective organization. Pre-vetting Organization re-use consent email notification will not be sent on order initiation, if the organization re-use token is submitted with your certificate order.
To get the prevetting token, please contact your Account administrator. | | representativeNumber | 21023 (optional)
Organization Representative Number of the existing Organization representative. It will consider default representative details of the respective organization (in case if it is not set). | **Certificate Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | organizationName | emudhra (mandatory)
Organization Name of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | organizationUnit | Bangalore Branch (optional)
Organization Unit of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | streetAddress1 | KIADB (mandatory)
Street Address 1 of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | streetAddress2 | Near Airport (optional)
Street Address 2 of Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | locality | 3rd Cross (mandatory)
Locality of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | state | Karnataka (mandatory)
State of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | countryCode | IN (mandatory)
Country Code of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | postalCode | 560064 (mandatory)

request.description:
This API facilitates to generate new order for all emSign - SSL / TLS - OV Wildcard - UCC certificates. **Prerequisites** eMudhra provides following values for generating SSL OV Orders. It is highly recommended to keep these values configurable, as they change for sandbox environment and Live environment. - Generate SSL Order Base URL Endpoint - Product Codes | **Region** | **URL** | | --- | --- | | US | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | | Global | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | **API Endpoint** | Header | Header | | --- | --- | | URL | http(s)://(url host port and path)/GenerateOrderSSL | | Protocol | HTTP/ HTTPS | | Method | POST | | Content Type | JSON | | Post data | A well-formed JSON, as per the specifications provided in this document. | **Request JSON format** Below is the JSON structure in which the request has to be formed. It must be well formed with correct syntax. ``` { "meta": { "ver":"", "ts":"", "txn":"", "accountNumber":"", "authKey":"" }, "orderDetails": { "productCode": "", "accountingModel": "", "saveAndHold": "", "requestNumber": "", "emailNotifications": "", "groupNumber ": "", "requestorInformation": { "requestorName": "", "requestorIsdCode": "", "requestorMobileNumber": "", "requestorEmail": "", "requestorDesignation": "" }, "delegationInformation": { "contactName": "", "email": "" }, "organizationDetails": { "preVetting": "", "organizationNumber": "", "prevettingToken": "", "representativeNumber": "" }, "certificateInformation": { "organizationName":"", "organizationUnit":"", "streetAddress1":"", "streetAddress2":"", "locality":"", "state":"", "countryCode":"", "postalCode":"", "domainName":"", "additionalDomains": [ "", "", ], "autoSecureWWW": "" }, "agreementDetails": { "acceptAgreement": "", "signerName": "", "signerPlace": "", "signerIP": "" }, "subscriptionDetails": { "validity": "", "autoRenew": "", "renewCriteria": "" }, "csr":"", "numberOfDocuments":"", "documentsAttached": [ { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" }, { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" } ], "additionalInformation": { "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" }, { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" } ], "remarks": "", "recipientEmail": "", "technicalPointOfContact": { "pocName":"", "pocEmail":"", "pocIsdCode":"", "pocMobileNumber":"", "pocDesignation":"" } } } } ``` **Specification** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | meta | (mandatory)
Specified Below. | | orderDetails | (mandatory)
Order details of the respective order.
Specified Below. | **Meta** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | ver | 1.0 (mandatory)
Version should be set to "1.0". | | ts | 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30 (mandatory)
Time stamp of request in ISO 8601 format. Example: 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30. Use Time zone to indicate the requesting server time. Else, it considers as Indian Time Zone. | | txn | 1234567890 (mandatory)
A unique transaction ID of the request. This should be unique for given Account. This should be an alphanumeric value between 10 to 50 characters. | | accountNumber | 6288275133 (mandatory)
Unique Account Number of CERTInext Account. This information will be available within CERTInext online portal. | | authKey | 952a95057654aa1c26a0f287b6368579f5f3ec99f213543df5e0f7eb7f798b3d (mandatory)
This should be the SHA 256 hash value of Account User Access Key Value along with Time Stamp and Transaction ID. Account User's REST API Access Key can be generated within CERTInext online portal. Example: SHA256 (accessKey + requestTs + requestTxnId). | **Order Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | productCode | 841 (mandatory)
Unique Product Code of the respective product. Product Code values are provided by eMudhra. | | accountingModel | 1 (optional)
Accounting Model of the Account.
The allowed value for this field is: 1 - Cash Model. The default value is '1' (in case if it is not set). | | saveAndHold | 0 (mandatory)
Should be set to any of the numeric values.
1 - Only Request ID will be generated and request will be pending for payment.
0 - Both Request ID & Order ID will be generated. | | requestNumber | 8785645678 (mandatory)
Request Number of the existing request which was saved as a draft.
This field is 'mandatory' only for the requests (Request ID is available & Order ID is yet to generate). | | emailNotifications | 1 (mandatory)
Can contain one of the numeric values as under. Default is '1'.
0 - Pre-vetting Organization (Organization & Subscriber Agreement info.) re-use consent notification will be sent to the applicant on order initiation, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'.
1 - All Order Notifications will be sent to the applicant on order initiation. | | groupNumber | 3589463147 (optional)
Group Number of the group. This is auto generated by the system. Groups can be your cost centers, departments, etc. within your Business.
It acts as a feature / tool for managing account user access to organizations, domains and finances. If group number is not given in the request, then system will consider the default group number and amount will be deducted from the account balance. If group is having its own balance, then amount will be deducted from the group balance else the amount will be deducted from the account balance. | | requestorInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | delegationInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | organizationDetails | (optional)
Specified below. | | certificateInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | agreementDetails | (conditional mandatory)
Signer details of the respective order to complete the Subscriber Agreement automatically. This is mandatory, if "preVetting" value is set to '0'. Specified Below. | | subscriptionDetails | (conditional mandatory)
Subscription Details of the order. | | csr | Optional | | numberOfDocuments | (optional)
Number of Documents attached. | | documentsAttached | (optional)
Uploading documents during order creation is recommended for sending us any additional / supporting documents so that they are automatically associated with your certificate order. This additional documentation would help emSign to speed up the certificate validation process. (E.g., incorporation letter, registration document, etc.). Specified below. | | additionalInformation | (optional)
Specified below. | **Requestor Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | requestorName | John Doe (mandatory)
Name of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorIsdCode | +1 (mandatory)
ISD Code of the requestor's / Org. Representative's mobile number. | | requestorMobileNumber | 8978945116 (mandatory)
Mobile number of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorEmail | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email of the requestor / Org. Representative. | | requestorDesignation | PM (optional)
Designation of the requestor / Org. Representative. | **Delegation Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | contactName | John Doe (mandatory)
Contact Name of the delegated person. | | email | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email ID of the delegated person. | **Organization Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | preVetting | 1 (mandatory)
This can be set to any of the numeric values as under. Default is '0'.
0 - No (New Organization)
1 - Yes (Pre-verified Domain of pre-vetted Organization). You are allowed to use Pre-verified EV Organizations in OV Orders as well. | | organizationNumber | 2943849 (conditional mandatory)
Organization Number (Org. ID) of the existing organization associated to the respective emSign account of the certificate requester.
This is mandatory, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | prevettingToken | 0947CBA3C2DF42B0B303590541C8E5B1 (optional)
Please specify the unique pre-vetted token value associated to the respective organization. Pre-vetting Organization re-use consent email notification will not be sent on order initiation, if the organization re-use token is submitted with your certificate order.
To get the prevetting token, please contact your Account administrator. | | representativeNumber | 21023 (optional)
Organization Representative Number of the existing Organization representative. It will consider default representative details of the respective organization (in case if it is not set). | **Certificate Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | organizationName | emudhra (mandatory)
Organization Name of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | organizationUnit | Bangalore Branch (optional)
Organization Unit of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | streetAddress1 | KIADB (mandatory)
Street Address 1 of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | streetAddress2 | Near Airport (optional)
Street Address 2 of Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | locality | 3rd Cross (mandatory)
Locality of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | state | Karnataka (mandatory)
State of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | countryCode | IN (mandatory)
Country Code of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | postalCode | 560064 (mandatory)

request.description:
This API facilitates to generate new order for emSign - SSL / TLS - EV certificates. **Prerequisites:** eMudhra provides following values for generating SSL EV Orders. It is highly recommended to keep these values configurable, as they change for sandbox environment and Live environment. - Generate SSL Order Base URL Endpoint - Product Codes | **Region** | **URL** | | --- | --- | | US | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | | Global | [https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/](https://sandbox-us.certinext.io/) | **API Endpoint** | Header | Header | | --- | --- | | URL | http(s)://(url host port and path)/GenerateOrderSSL | | Protocol | HTTP/ HTTPS | | Method | POST | | Content Type | JSON | | Post data | A well-formed JSON, as per the specifications provided in this document. | **Request JSON format** Below is the JSON structure in which the request has to be formed. It must be well formed with correct syntax. ``` { "meta": { "ver":"", "ts":"", "txn":"", "accountNumber":"", "authKey":"" }, "orderDetails": { "productCode":"", "accountingModel":"", "saveAndHold":"", "requestNumber":"", "emailNotifications":"", "groupNumber":"", "requestorInformation": { "requestorName": "", "requestorIsdCode": "", "requestorMobileNumber": "", "requestorEmail": "", "requestorDesignation": "" }, "delegationInformation": { "contactName": "", "email": "" }, "organizationDetails": { "preVetting": "", "organizationNumber": "", "representativeNumber": "" }, "certificateInformation": { "organizationName":"", "organizationUnit":"", "businessCategory":"", "companyDuns":"", "streetAddress1":"", "streetAddress2":"", "locality":"", "state":"", "countryCode":"", "postalCode":"", "domainName":"", "additionalDomains": [ "", "", ], "autoSecureWWW": "" }, "contractSignerInfo": { "name":"", "email":"", "isdCode":"", "mobileNumber":"", "designation":"", "employeeID":"", }, "certificateApproverInfo": { "name":"", "email":"", "isdCode":"", "mobileNumber":"", "designation":"", "employeeID":"", }, "subscriptionDetails": { "validity": "", "autoRenew": "", "renewCriteria": "" }, "csr":"", "numberOfDocuments":"", "documentsAttached": [ { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" }, { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" } ], "additionalInformation": { "remarks": "", "recipientEmail": "", "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" }, { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" } ], "technicalPointOfContact": { "pocName":"", "pocEmail":"", "pocIsdCode":"", "pocMobileNumber":"", "pocDesignation":"" } } } } ``` **Specification** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | meta | (mandatory)
Specified Below. | | orderDetails | (mandatory)
Order details of the respective order.
Specified Below. | **Meta** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | ver | 1.0 (mandatory)
Version should be set to "1.0". | | ts | 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30 (mandatory)
Time stamp of request in ISO 8601 format. Example: 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30. Use Time zone to indicate the requesting server time. Else, it considers as Indian Time Zone. | | txn | 1234567890 (mandatory)
A unique transaction ID of the request. This should be unique for given Account. This should be an alphanumeric value between 10 to 50 characters. | | accountNumber | 6288275133 (mandatory)
Unique Account Number of CERTInext Account. This information will be available within CERTInext online portal. | | authKey | 952a95057654aa1c26a0f287b6368579f5f3ec99f213543df5e0f7eb7f798b3d (mandatory)
This should be the SHA 256 hash value of Account User Access Key Value along with Time Stamp and Transaction ID. Account User's REST API Access Key can be generated within CERTInext online portal. Example: SHA256 (accessKey + requestTs + requestTxnId). | **Order Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | productCode | 850 (mandatory)
Unique Product Code of the respective product. Product Code values are provided by eMudhra. | | accountingModel | 1 (optional)
Accounting Model of the Account.
The allowed value for this field is: 1 - Cash Model. The default value is '1' (in case if it is not set). | | saveAndHold | 0 (mandatory)
Should be set to any of the numeric values.
1 - Only Request ID will be generated and request will be pending for payment.
0 - Both Request ID & Order ID will be generated. | | requestNumber | 5652671652 (mandatory)
Request Number of the existing request which was saved as a draft.
This field is 'mandatory' only for the requests (Request ID is available & Order ID is yet to generate). | | emailNotifications | 1 (mandatory)
Can contain one of the numeric values as under. Default is '1'.
0 - Pre-vetting Organization (Organization & Subscriber Agreement info.) re-use consent notification will be sent to the applicant on order initiation, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'.
1 - All Order Notifications will be sent to the applicant on order initiation. | | groupNumber | 3589463147 (optional)
Group Number of the group. This is auto generated by the system. Groups can be your cost centers, departments, etc. within your Business.
It acts as a feature / tool for managing account user access to organizations, domains and finances. If group number is not given in the request, then system will consider the default group number and amount will be deducted from the account balance. If group is having its own balance, then amount will be deducted from the group balance else the amount will be deducted from the account balance. | | requestorInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | delegationInformation | (optional)
Specified below. | | organizationDetails | (conditional mandatory)
This is mandatory, If prevetting is set to '0'.
Specified below. | | certificateInformation | (mandatory)
Specified below. | | contractSignerInfo | (conditional mandatory)
This is mandatory, if Prevetting is set to '0'.
Specified below. | | certificateApproverInfo | (conditional mandatory)
This is mandatory, if Prevetting is set to '0'.
Specified below. | | subscriptionDetails | (conditional mandatory)
Subscription Details of the order. | | csr | (optional)
CSR means Certificate Signing Request. CSR file has to be generated, preferably in the web server, or with any standard tools. You should ensure that the corresponding private key resides in same web server / tool, so that you can import the SSL / TLS certificate in the same, once it is issued. Applicable for all SSL / TLS products. | | numberOfDocuments | (optional)
Number of Documents attached. | | documentsAttached | (optional)
Uploading documents during order creation is recommended for sending us any additional / supporting documents so that they are automatically associated with your certificate order. This additional documentation would help emSign to speed up the certificate validation process. (E.g., incorporation letter, registration document, etc.). Specified below. | | additionalInformation | (optional)
Specified below. | **Requestor Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | requestorName | John Doe (mandatory)
Name of the requestor. | | requestorIsdCode | +1 (mandatory)
ISD Code of the requestor's mobile number. | | requestorMobileNumber | 9867542762 (mandatory)
Mobile number of the requestor. | | requestorEmail | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email of the requestor. | | requestorDesignation | BA (optional)
Designation of the requestor. | **Delegation Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | contactName | John Doe (mandatory)
Contact Name of the delegated person. | | email | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email ID of the delegated person. | **Organization Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | preVetting | 0 (mandatory)
This can be set to any of the numeric values as under. Default is '0'.
0 - No (New Organization)
1 - Yes (Pre-verified EV Organization) | | organizationNumber | (conditional mandatory)
Organization Number (Org. ID) of the existing organization associated to the respective emSign account of the certificate requester. This is mandatory, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | representativeNumber | 4567876 (optional)
Organization Representative Number of the existing Organization representative. It will consider default requestor information of the respective order. (in case if it is not set). | **Certificate Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | organizationName | eMudhra Limited (mandatory)
Organization Name of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | organizationUnit | (optional)
Organization Unit of the respective Organization. | | businessCategory | 1 (mandatory)
Business Category of an Organization.
The allowed values for this field are:
1 - Private Organization
2 - Government Entity | | companyDuns | 222888778865426726524 (mandatory)
Company Registration Number or Company DUNS Number of an Organization. | | streetAddress1 | KIADB (mandatory)
Street Address 1 of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | streetAddress2 | (optional)
Street address 2 of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | locality | KIADB (mandatory)
Locality of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | state | Karnataka (mandatory)
State of an organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | countryCode | IN (mandatory)
Country code of Organization.
This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | postalCode | 560076 (mandatory)
Postal code of the respective Organization. This field is not required, if "preVetting" value is set to '1'. | | domainName | emudhra.com (mandatory)
Domain Name of the website / server. If the pre-verified domain under the pre-vetted organization (if "preVetting" value is set to '1') is provided then fresh DCV is not required. | | additionalDomainNames | support.emudhra.com (mandatory)
Additional domain names of the website / server. This field is required only for SSL multi-domain / UCC products as specified below.
Applicable for SSL / TLS EV - UCC products. | | autoSecureWWW | 1 (mandatory)
This is set to '1' by default.
1 - Enabled (Secure 'www' variant of website)
0 - Disabled (Doesn't secure 'www' variant of website)
If user has chosen to secure website with both www and without www variants, then File-based (HTTP / HTTPs URL) DCV method is not allowed to verify DCV. | **Contract Signer Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | name | John Doe (mandatory)
Name of the Contract Signer. | | email | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email ID of the Contract Signer. | | isdCode | +1 (mandatory)
ISD Code of the Contract Signer's Mobile Number. | | mobileNumber | 92673626528 (mandatory)
Mobile Number of the Contract Signer. | | designation | PM (mandatory)
Designation of the Contract Signer. | | employeeID | 25615 (optional)
Employee ID of the Contract Signer. | **Certificate Approver Information** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | name | John Doe (mandatory)
Name of the Certificate Approver. | | email | [johndoe@example.com](https://johndoe@example.com) (mandatory)
Email ID of the Certificate Approver. | | isdCode | +1 (mandatory)
ISD Code of the Certificate Approver's Mobile Number. | | mobileNumber | 8726728726 (mandatory)
Mobile Number of the Certificate Approver. | | designation | PO (mandatory)
Designation of the Certificate Approver. | | employeeID | 762521(optional)
Employee ID of the Certificate Approver. | **Subscription Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | validity | 1 (optional)
Validity of the Subscription (1 / 2 / 3 Years).

This API facilitates to generate new order for emSign - SSL / TLS - EV - UCC certificates. **Prerequisites:** eMudhra provides following values for generating SSL EV Orders. It must be well formed with correct syntax. ``` { "meta": { "ver":"", "ts":"", "txn":"", "accountNumber":"", "authKey":"" }, "orderDetails": { "productCode":"", "accountingModel":"", "saveAndHold":"", "requestNumber":"", "emailNotifications":"", "groupNumber":"", "requestorInformation": { "requestorName": "", "requestorIsdCode": "", "requestorMobileNumber": "", "requestorEmail": "", "requestorDesignation": "" }, "delegationInformation": { "contactName": "", "email": "" }, "organizationDetails": { "preVetting": "", "organizationNumber": "", "representativeNumber": "" }, "certificateInformation": { "organizationName":"", "organizationUnit":"", "businessCategory":"", "companyDuns":"", "streetAddress1":"", "streetAddress2":"", "locality":"", "state":"", "countryCode":"", "postalCode":"", "domainName":"", "additionalDomains": [ "", "", ], "autoSecureWWW": "" }, "contractSignerInfo": { "name":"", "email":"", "isdCode":"", "mobileNumber":"", "designation":"", "employeeID":"", }, "certificateApproverInfo": { "name":"", "email":"", "isdCode":"", "mobileNumber":"", "designation":"", "employeeID":"", }, "subscriptionDetails": { "validity": "", "autoRenew": "", "renewCriteria": "" }, "csr":"", "numberOfDocuments":"", "documentsAttached": [ { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" }, { "id":"", "fileName":"", "description":"", "base64Value":"" } ], "additionalInformation": { "remarks": "", "recipientEmail": "", "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" }, { "fieldID": "", "fieldValue": "" } ], "technicalPointOfContact": { "pocName":"", "pocEmail":"", "pocIsdCode":"", "pocMobileNumber":"", "pocDesignation":"" } } } } ``` **Specification** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | meta | (mandatory)

This should be the SHA 256 hash value of Account User Access Key Value along with Time Stamp and Transaction ID. Account User's REST API Access Key can be generated within CERTInext online portal. For multiple status, please provide comma separated values. | | certExpiryDateFrom | 2025-03-15T13:24:11+05:30 (optional) Specify the certificate expiry from date in ISO 8601 format in UTC time zone. All the expired certificates are fetched till the specified date mentioned. It shall be considered with the time zone representation. The allowed date formats for this field are: YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. e.g.: 2022-12-15T13:24:11+05:30. This is mandatory, if 'certExpiryDateTill' is provided. | | certExpiryDateTill | 2025-03-15T13:24:11+05:30 (optional) Specify the certificate expiry till date in ISO 8601 format in UTC time zone. All the expired certificates are fetched from the date specified to till date. It shall be considered with the time zone representation. The allowed date formats for this field are: YYYY-MM-DD / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS / YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. e.g.: 2022-12-15T13:24:11+05:30. This is mandatory, if 'certExpiryDateFrom' is provided. | | requestorEmailId | [support@emudhra.com ](https://support@emudhra.com) (optional)
Registered Email ID of the certificate requestor associated with the respective emSign Certificate Order. For multiple requestors, please provide comma separated values. | | pageNumber | 1 (optional)
Page number of the report.
The default value is 1 (in case if it is not set). | | pageSize | 50 (optional)
Page size of the report.
The only allowed value is 100. | | tagSearchCriteria | (optional)
Specify the tag search criteria if multiple tags are provided.
The allowed values are: 1 - OR Condition & 2 - AND Condition.
The default value is 1 (in case if it is not set). | | certificateChain | (optional)
The allowed values are 0 and 1.
If "0" is passed, the response will not have the Certificate chain.
If "1" is passed, the response will include the Certificate chain. | | certificateTrustType | (optional)
"1" = Public, the response will return only Public trust certificates.
"2" = Private, the response will return only Private trust certificates.
If the field is left empty, the response will return both Public and Private trust certificates. | | issuerCA | (optional)
Issuer CA based search.
e.g; issuerCA: "IGFT" | | tags | (optional)
Reporting tags are labels with different values, which can be associated with your certificate orders in CERTInext. These tags can then be used to filter reports, giving you a categorized insight into your business. Tag Name and Tag Value must be colon separated values.
e.g.: Department:Technology. Multiple tag names and tag values can be associated with the order.
e.g.: (Department:Technology, Department:Legal, Branch Location:India).
Specified below. | **Tags** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | Tag Name | Dept (mandatory)
Reporting Tag Name. | | Tag Value | Technology (mandatory)
Reporting Tag Value. | **Response JSON format** Below is the JSON structure in which the response is provided. The correlation can be made against the transaction ID (txn) attribute present in the request. ``` { "meta":{ "ver":"", "ts":"", "txn":"", "status":"", "errorCode":"", "errorMessage":"" }, "orderDetails":{ "pageSize":"", "currentPage":"", "totalNoOfResults":"", "noOfPages":"", "ordersArray":[ { "orderNumber":"", "requestNumber":"", "productCode":"", "groupNumber":"", "certificateStatusId":"", "certificateStatus":"", "orderStatusId":"", "orderStatus":"", "orderDate":"", "organizationName":"", "domainName":"", "countryName":"", "certificateSerialNumber":"", "certificateExpiryDate":"", "certificateChain": "", "certificateTrustType": "", "issuerCA": "", "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID":"", "fieldName":"", "fieldValue":"" }, { "fieldID":"", "fieldName":"", "fieldValue":"" } ] }, { "orderNumber":"", "requestNumber":"", "productCode":"", "groupNumber":"", "certificateStatusId":"", "certificateStatus":"", "orderStatusId":"", "orderStatus":"", "orderDate":"", "organizationName":"", "domainName":"", "countryName":"", "certificateSerialNumber":"", "certificateExpiryDate":"", "certificateChain": "", "certificateTrustType": "", "issuerCA": "", "tags":[ "(Tag Name:Tag Value)", "(Tag Name:Tag Value)" ], "customFields":[ { "fieldID":"", "fieldName":"", "fieldValue":"" }, { "fieldID":"", "fieldName":"", "fieldValue":"" } ] } ] } } ``` **Specification** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | meta | (mandatory)
Specified Below. | | orderDetails | (mandatory)
Specified Below. | **Meta** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | ver | 1.0 (mandatory)
Version should be set to "1.0". | | ts | 2023-01-31T14:19:28+05:30 (mandatory)
Time stamp of response in ISO 8601 format. It shall be considered with the time zone representation. | | txn | 1234567890 (mandatory)
This value will contain the transaction ID as received in request JSON, and shall be used to co-relate the request and responses. | | status | 1 (mandatory)
1 - Success
0 - Failure | | errorCode | (conditional mandatory)
Optional in case of success.
Mandatory in case of failure. | | errorMessage | (conditional mandatory)
Optional in case of success.
Mandatory in case of failure. | **Order Details** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | pageSize | 1 (mandatory)
Total number of results in the current page. The default size is 100. | | currentPage | 1 (mandatory)
Numeric value of the current page. This will contain the 'pageNumber' value as received in the request. | | totalNoOfResults | 1000 (mandatory)
Total number of results available. | | noOfPages | 100 (mandatory)
Total number of pages available. | | ordersArray | (mandatory)
Specified below. | **Orders Arrays** | Name of the Attribute | Specification | | --- | --- | | orderNumber | 8276384767 (mandatory)
Order Number of the respective Certificate Order. | | requestNumber | 6765456787 (mandatory)
Request Number of the respective Certificate Order. | | productCode | 844 (mandatory)
Unique Product Code of the respective product. Product Code values are provided by eMudhra. | | groupNumber | 8194218742 (optional)
Group Number of the group. This is auto generated by the system. Groups can be your cost centers, departments, etc. within your Business. It acts as a feature / tool for managing account user access to organizations, domains and finances. If group number is not given in the request, then system will consider the default group number and amount will be deducted from the account balance. If group is having its own balance, then amount will be deducted from the group balance else the amount will be deducted from the account balance. | | certificateStatusId | 1 (conditional mandatory)

Order Date of the respective order. | | organizationName | eMudhra (conditional mandatory)
Name of the organization. This is mandatory for emSign SSL - OV & EV products. | | domainName | emsign.com (conditional mandatory)
Domain Name of the website / server. | | countryName | IN (conditional mandatory)

If "0" is passed, the response will not have the Certificate chain.

The allowed values are 1 and 2.
"1" = Public, the response will return only Public trust certificates.
"2" = Private, the response will return only Private trust certificates.
If the field is left empty, the response will return both Public and Private trust certificates. | | issuerCA | | | tagName:tagValue | Department:Technology (optional)
Tag Name and Tag Value of the Certificate. e.g.: Department:Technology. Multiple tag names and tag values can be associated with the order. e.g.:Department:Technology, Department:Legal, Branch Location:India | | fieldName:value | BusinessUnit:IJH43 (optional)

Fill all the Details. | Field Name | Field Specifications | | --- | --- | | Description | Mandatory | | User | Mandatory | | Groups | Mandatory | | Product | Mandatory | | Tags | Optional | - Click on Generate EAB Credentials to generate ACME EAB Credentials. **NOTE**: Multiple users (and/or) groups cannot be mapped for a pair of Key ID & Mac Key. item.name: Generation of emSign TLS DV using ACME Certbot
item.description:

**Path**: Login CERTInext portal > Integration > ACME APIs > New ACME EAB Credentials > Fill the details > Generate EAB Credentials. | | Config dir | Configuration file path of the cerbot application. | | Work dir | Specify a path for input data. | | Logs dir | Specify a path for input data. | | Key Type | RSA Algorithm. | | RSA Key size | RSA Algorithm with 2048. |

item.name: Benefits of ACME
item.description:
The Automatic Certificate Management Environment (ACME) protocol offers several benefits for managing and securing web communications, particularly through the use of SSL/TLS certificates. Here are some key advantages:

- **Automation**: ACME automates the process of obtaining, validating, and renewing SSL/TLS certificates. This automation reduces the administrative burden on website owners, making it easier to maintain secure connections.
    
- **Enhanced Security:** By automating the certificate management process, ACME encourages more frequent certificate renewal. Shorter certificate lifetimes mean that compromised certificates are valid for a shorter duration, enhancing overall security.
    
- **Cost-Effective:** ACME is a cost-effective solution for availing Free SSL/TLS certificates, especially for individuals and organizations with budget constraints.
    
- **Improved HTTPS Adoption**: The simplified process of obtaining and renewing certificates encourages website owners to implement HTTPS, leading to a more secure web environment. This is crucial for protecting user data and ensuring the integrity of online communications.
    
- **Flexible Validation Methods:** ACME supports multiple methods for domain validation, including HTTP-based validation (placing a file on the web server), DNS-based validation, and TLS-based validation. This flexibility allows website owners to choose the most suitable method for their infrastructure.
    
- **Open Standards:** ACME is designed as an open protocol, encouraging interoperability and standardization. This openness promotes a consistent and widely adopted approach to certificate management.
    
- **Reduced Downtime:** Automated certificate renewal reduces the risk of certificate expiration, minimizing the potential for service disruptions due to expired certificates. This is especially critical for maintaining the availability and reliability of websites.
    
- **Wildcard Certificate Support:** ACME supports the issuance of wildcard certificates, allowing website owners to secure not only a specific subdomain but all its subdomains with a single certificate.
    
- **Ease of Implementation:** ACME's well-defined protocol and the availability of client libraries make it relatively easy for system administrators and developers to integrate ACME into their infrastructure.
    

Overall, the ACME protocol, has played a significant role in simplifying the process of securing web communications and promoting a more secure online environment.

ACME stands for Automated Certificate Management Environment. emSign's ACME service is meticulously crafted to simplify the automation of SSL/TLS processes, mitigating the complexity and effort associated with managing numerous certificates within an enterprise. With organizations juggling a multitude of certificates, each demanding significant time and effort, ACME proves invaluable by completely automating the essential procedures needed to oversee SSL/TLS certificates across all endpoints in your organization. It provides an easy-to-use method of automating interactions between emSign CA and a web server.

**NOTE:** Unlike REST APIs for which you are using Postman, for using our ACME service you have to use any type of ACME client that supports EAB authorization. There are many ACME clients such as win-acme, certbot, etc. available in this space. Most of these tools are free to use and created to simplify use of the ACME protocol.
